title: Disney Parks Lilo & Stitch Themed Coffee Mug 12 oz Ohana Means Family Gold
descriptionText:
This Disney Parks Lilo & Stitch themed coffee mug is the perfect addition to any Disneyana collection. With a capacity of 12 oz, it is perfect for your morning coffee or tea. The mug features a beautiful design by Ohana Means Family in gold and is made in Thailand.

The mug is officially licensed by Disney and features the beloved characters Lilo & Stitch. It is a must-have for any fan of the franchise and makes a great gift. Add this unique mug to your collection today!
